message: glib 0.18.5: unsoundness in Iterator and DoubleEndedIterator impls for glib::VariantStrIter (MEDIUM), fixed in glib 0.20.0
why: The desktop app gets glib through Tauri (tauri 2.12.1 -> tao 0.37 / wry -> gtk 0.18 -> glib 0.18). Even the newest Tauri and tao still require gtk ^0.18, which pins glib 0.18, so cargo update cannot reach 0.20. Kompanion's own code never touches glib. A fix by us is not possible without leaving Tauri or forking gtk-rs.

options.name: Accept until Tauri moves
options.tradeoff: Record this one advisory in .trivyignore.yaml with an expiry date (3 months) and the reason; trivy then fails again on that date so we re-check whether Tauri moved to gtk-rs 0.20+. Every other finding still blocks. Risk: the unsound iterator stays in the Linux desktop build, which never calls it.

options.name: Patch glib ourselves
options.tradeoff: Vendor glib 0.18 with the upstream fix through [patch.crates-io]. Removes the bug for real, but trivy still reads version 0.18.x and keeps reporting it, so it needs the same ignore entry anyway, plus a fork to maintain.

options.name: Drop the Linux desktop app
options.tradeoff: Remove the Tauri desktop wrapper until Tauri supports gtk4; the web app and the Android app stay. Clears the advisory, but Linux users lose the tray app and native notifications.

options.name: Leave it waiting
options.tradeoff: Change nothing: this item stays in the lint report as waiting and does not block other merges. The advisory stays visible until Tauri updates.
